items.quote: What is the maximum sustained wind speed recorded during the storm with the highest maximum storm category?
items.description: 找出 max_storm_cat 最高的風暴（平手取檔案序首列），回傳該列 max_sust_wind，與 answer.txt 的 @max_wind_speed 比對。

items.quote:
Put each answer item on its own line, in the form `@name[value]`, using exactly the
names given under "Answer format" in the task. This task expects 1 item(s):
`@max_wind_speed[...]`.
items.description: answer.txt 須含 @max_wind_speed[數字] 格式項目，數值為兩位小數的 float。
